title: Migration 0012 FK constraint may fail when multiple users' messages exist
description: Migration 0012_drop_user_id_messages.sql copies all mailbox_messages rows to the new messages table with FK constraint ON mailbox_id → mailboxes(mailbox_id). But migration 0011 only preserved mailbox_id values from the MIN(user_id) user. When mailbox_messages has rows from other users with different mailbox_id values, those rows become orphaned in the new table. If FK constraints are enabled (currently disabled by default in SQLite but may be enabled in tests/production), the INSERT will fail with a FK violation. Correct behavior: either preserve ALL mailboxes from all users in migration 0011, or remove the FK constraint and handle orphaned rows.
